Questions

Is RydAR free?

Yes. RydAR is a free download on the App Store, with no account and no ads.

Does it need a cell signal?

No. The Arkansas curve database ships inside the app, so warnings don’t wait on the network.

Does it work outside Arkansas?

Curve warnings cover Arkansas roads for now. A trip that leaves the state keeps running and says it has no curve data there.

Is the suggested speed a speed limit?

No. It is a computed range for the bend, separate from any posted sign. How it works.

Is it good for teen drivers?

Teen driver mode speaks the same curve warnings and buzzes twice before each one, with no screen to look at and no camera.

Is there an Android app?

RydAR is an iPhone app. The curve map works in any browser, including on Android.

Free on the App Store. Set up while parked.
